title: Fractional Rotation, Full Potential? Investigating Performance and Convergence of Partial RoPE
abstract: arXiv:2603.11611v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) is widely used in transformers to encode relative positional information, yet the effect of applying RoPE to only a subset of hidden dimensions remains underexplored. This design choice can substantially reduce memory usage, especially at long context lengths. We show that partial RoPE achieves up to 10$\times$ memory savings over standard RoPE cache while maintaining comparable final loss. We systematically study its impact on training dynamics and convergence across architectures, model sizes, sequence lengths, and datasets. Our results reveal that: (1) applying RoPE to only a small fraction of dimensions (around 10\%) matches the convergence of full RoPE; (2) these trends remain consistent across settings; and (3) NoPE (No Positional Encoding) can produce loss spikes, which are mitigated by minimal RoPE usage or QK-Norm application. translated_title: 部分旋转，全部潜力？探究部分RoPE的性能与收敛性
translated_abstract: 旋转位置编码（RoPE）被广泛应用于Transformer中以编码相对位置信息，然而仅对隐层维度的一个子集应用RoPE的效果仍未得到充分探索。这种设计选择可以大幅减少内存使用，尤其是在长上下文场景下。我们证明部分RoPE相比标准RoPE缓存可实现高达10倍的内存节省，同时保持相当的最终损失。我们系统地研究了其对训练动态和收敛性的影响，涵盖了不同的架构、模型规模、序列长度和数据集。我们的结果揭示：（1）仅对约10%的维度应用RoPE即可达到与完整RoPE相当的收敛性；（2）这些趋势在各种设置下保持一致；（3）NoPE（无位置编码）可能产生损失尖峰，而最小限度的RoPE使用或QK-Norm的应用可以缓解这一问题。总体而言，我们的发现表明部分RoPE是一种有效的...
tldr: 仅对约10%的隐藏维度应用旋转位置编码（部分RoPE）即可达到与完整RoPE相当的收敛性能，同时实现高达10倍的内存节省，且最小限度的RoPE使用或QK-Norm可缓解NoPE导致的损失尖峰。
en_tdlr: Applying RoPE to only ~10% of hidden dimensions (partial RoPE) matches the convergence of full RoPE while achieving up to 10× memory savings, and minimal RoPE usage or QK-Norm mitigates the loss spikes caused by NoPE.
